pages.text: Tourists come into shops to buy, and the elements they pay land in the town warehouse. What a shop stocks is fixed by the building; what you control is the maximum stock of each item, and it starts at zero, so a shop you have not set up never stocks anything.$(br2)When goods run low the shop asks the warehouse for the real items and has the Workstation craft them if the warehouse is empty, so build shops together with a warehouse and a workstation. A shop with nothing in stock contributes nothing to the town's three values.
